title: Pointsicle onchain
tagline: Seduce them onchain! An open standard to create gamified incentives to bring everybody onchain.
description:
Make the world a better place! Breaking free from the centralised shackles! We created on open standard for onchain quests that empowers builders to permissionlessly publish seducing quests which make onboarding to onchain fun.
It enables builders to simply create quests however they imaging their quests. All created quests will automatically be published on a website.
how_its_made:
We came up with a minimalistic subgraph schema interface that creates an open standard to create quests. Anybody can create a subgraph that adheres to that schema and design its own quests thanks to the flexibility of subgraphs.

All subgraphs that adhere to that schema are automatically be included into the website which is built with Scaffold-Eth 2 and Shadcn on pointsicle.com
